A crayon is shorter than a pencil

cards.back: Has the most length of three or more.
cards.example: rope, ribbon, string: the rope is longest

cards.back: Has the least length of three or more.
A same‑size object used to measure.
Units touch with no gaps and no overlaps.
cards.example: cubes lined up in a row

cards.back: Line up the ends at the same starting line.

cards.front: Rope is longer than the desk. Desk is longer than the box. Rope or box?
A pencil is 7 cubes long. What does that mean?
cards.back: 7 same‑size cubes fit end to end along it.
The count is too small. Units must touch.
The count is too big. Units must not overlap.
Not fair. Use units that are all the same size.

cards.front: Pencil 8 cubes, crayon 5 cubes. How much longer?
Paper clips or craft sticks: which takes more?
cards.back: Paper clips. Smaller units need more.
